title: 08 · Undertow: podcast now playing (phone, 390×844 @3x, dark)
strengths: A real editorial idea carried through: the episode title as a 54 px light serif over the art, the current transcript line as a pull-quote with a fill-box highlight, chapters set as a table of contents with dotted leaders and times.
A chapter-aware scrubber (six segments), 1.2× speed, skip 15 and 30, a sleep moon: the real control set for long-form listening.
Zero radius everywhere and one ice-blue accent: the print idea is held in every element.
slop_signals: The cover art is generated contour-map texture with a glowing moon and a decorative coordinate label '46°12'N': the topographic-texture motif recurs across this showcase (also on the banking card).
The first name 'Ines' and the value '18:24' appear in other pieces of the set: reused invented data.
fixes: Use a real or commissioned cover image for the show, or a flat typographic cover; drop the coordinate label and the moon glow.
Vary names and numbers across the showcase.
